_description: Full data provenance for GEDS graph parameters. Every numeric parameter in seed_data.py traces to one of these sources.

sources.description: Bilateral semiconductor trade flows, HS codes 8541 (diodes/transistors) and 8542 (integrated circuits). Import-side data used for dependency computation.
sources.formula: dependency_weight(TWN→X, semi) = sum(M_{X,TWN,8541} + M_{X,TWN,8542}) / sum(M_{X,World,8541} + M_{X,World,8542})
sources.formula_name: Import penetration ratio (standard trade economics measure, cf. Feenstra & Taylor 2014)
caveats: China figure likely understates true dependency by ~5pp due to Hong Kong re-export routing
Netherlands figure understates economic exposure as ASML sells equipment (HS 8486) not chips
USA figure understates fabless design exposure (IP in USA, fabrication in Taiwan)
India bilateral query returned null; estimate used

sources.description: Bilateral passenger vehicle trade flows, HS code 8703. Used for automotive sector dependency weights.
Total energy imports by country, HS codes 2709 (crude oil) and 2710 (refined petroleum). Used for energy node GDP calibration.
GDP at current USD for 11 countries. Taiwan sourced separately from IMF WEO.
sources.sector_share_source: OECD STAN Database for Structural Analysis (2020 edition), manufacturing value added by industry

sources.description: Overall LPI score (1=low to 5=high) for 11 countries. Used to calibrate vulnerability and resilience parameters.
sources.formula_rationale: Scales LPI to [0.20, 0.80] range to avoid degenerate edge values while preserving relative ordering. LPI_min=3.05 (MEX), LPI_max=4.20 (DEU) within our 12-country panel.
caveats: Taiwan LPI not in World Bank dataset (non-member state). Estimated value 3.55 from academic secondary sources.

sources.description: Taiwan nominal GDP in current USD. World Bank does not publish Taiwan GDP.

sources.source: International Energy Agency, World Energy Outlook 2020
sources.description: Fraction of country energy imports transiting each major chokepoint. Used to calibrate chokepoint dependency_weight edges.

sources.source: IMO/Lloyd's List Historical Disruption Statistics; academic synthesis in Rodrigue (2020) 'The Geography of Transport Systems'
sources.description: Annual baseline probability of significant disruption at each chokepoint.

CP:TaiwanStrait.basis: geopolitical tension frequency, Lloyd's Risk Index 2019

CP:Malacca.basis: piracy incidents + weather events, IMO piracy statistics

CP:Suez.basis: historical incidents including 2021 event, Suez Canal Authority data

CP:Hormuz.basis: geopolitical tension frequency, US EIA Hormuz analysis 2019

sources.source: OECD STAN Database for Structural Analysis
sources.description: Manufacturing value added as % of GDP by industry and country, 2019 edition. Used to allocate country-level GDP to industry nodes.
sources.note: Sector shares applied as: node_gdp = country_gdp_2019 * sector_share. Shares are approximate (2-3 sig. fig.) due to industry classification alignment between STAN and GEDS sector taxonomy.

quality_codes.real: Fetched directly from official API; fully traceable
quality_codes.literature: Taken from peer-reviewed publication or official statistical report; citable
quality_codes.estimated: Computed from secondary sources or interpolated; flagged with rationale

parameters_not_from_real_data.rationale: Calibrated to match historical COVID/auto-chip event magnitude. No direct empirical source. Sensitivity analysis in /api/v1/sensitivity shows CSI_peak changes by ±0.12 for amplification ∈ [1.0, 2.0].
Sigmoid activation threshold for nonlinear amplification. Set to 0.50 for most nodes; lower (0.40) for chokepoints which trigger amplification earlier.
Calibrated from industry reports: TSMC quoted 12-18 month lead times; shipping recovery 2-4 weeks; automotive 16-24 weeks (FRB FEDS Notes 2021).
Sector-specific. Semiconductors: 0.80-0.90 (TSMC controls 54% of global foundry market; HHI ≈ 3800 on 10k scale). Oil: 0.30 (fungible commodity). Automotive: 0.50-0.65.
